universityName: Pohang University of Science And Technology (POSTECH)
description: POSTECH Library database AI search that answers research questions from reliable sources with citations.
howToObtain: Open the POSTECH Library AI-based paper-search service.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: POSTECH Library's guide lists AI-based Paper Search (Primo Research Assistant) among AI features available in Library databases. It says the service answers a research question using reliable sources and provides a summarized answer with its five most relevant cited sources.

universityName: Pohang University of Science And Technology (POSTECH)

evidence.evidenceSnippet: POSTECH describes POSTECH AI as a multi-LLM generative AI service for members that includes ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude, and says entered user data is designed not to be used for external model retraining.
이 플랫폼은 ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude 등 세계 최고 수준의 모델을 한곳에 담아, 사용자가 연구와 업무 목적에 따라 최적의 모델을 선택할 수 있는 폭넓은 환경을 제공합니다.
